model.name: Sprint selection populates detail drawer
model.description: Selecting a Sprint node in the traceability tree POPULATES the detail drawer with that sprint's detail (name, goal, task slots), instead of an empty/stale drawer. Impl: RbDetailDrawer.renderDetailForRef sprint-case (deployed v0.7.11).

discoverySource.note: S30 traceability improvement — sprint selection populates the detail drawer; minted by skill-expert (drive: req/planner rate-limited) to trace deployed v0.7.11 fix.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Selecting/clicking a SPRINT node updates the detail drawer to show THAT sprint details.
THE BUG: selecting a sprint did NOT change the drawer content.
selection->drawer works for ALL tree node types (sprint/task/etc) - shows the selected unit details (fix on RbDetailDrawer.renderDetailForRef).

model.reconcileNote: CANONICAL (task-covered). Un-tombstoned + ACs enriched to the full Tron set 2026-07-13 by robbin-req; the parallel-mint dup (my 15c8fe45/c1a0b382) was deleted. v0.7.11 retroactive #126.
